d:
"Pockets Full of Flows" is about Siyaahi's rise as a confident, self-made rapper who faces challenges and competition head-on. He calls out fake rappers, showcases his unique style, and asserts his dominance in the rap game. The track blends aggression, confidence, and street wisdom
Song Credits
Track Name: Pocket Full Of Flows
Written & Performed By: Siyaahi
Music Producer: Aditya Pushkarna
Primary Artist: Siyaahi
Track Name: Pocket Full Of Flows
Singer/Performed By/Cast: Siyaahi
